query:
SELECT
                COALESCE(SUM(CAST(order_total_amount AS DECIMAL)), 0) as "revenue!: rust_decimal::Decimal",
                COUNT(*) as "count!"
            FROM admin.amazon_orders
            WHERE order_status != 'Canceled'
              AND purchase_date >= $1::date
              AND purchase_date < ($2::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
